title: How Many Shares of Hershey or Mondelez Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about 2,066 Hershey shares (about $360,000) or about 5,770 Mondelez shares (about $389,700). Hershey’s higher yield makes it about $29,700 cheaper, and its dividend used 53% of free cash flow over the last 12 months, against 70% at Mondelez.
